C0217.title: Guangdong Economic and Information Officials Sentenced for Fabricating Materials to Defraud Subsidy Funds
keywords: Chang'an Town Economic and Information Bureau
C0217.summary: The National Audit Office’s 2017 Announcement No. 30 disclosed that Jing Xiuyuan allegedly colluded with Huang Xinzheng, former section chief of Dongguan Chang’an economic and information bureau, and others to forge materials and misappropriate more than RMB 12 million in central fiscal subsidies for closing small enterprises. In July 2016, Guangdong High People’s Court convicted Huang of corruption and sentenced him to 13 years in prison, Jing to 10 years and six months, and Chen Weibin to three years suspended for three years, with property confiscation and fines imposed.
